context:
Goal: each phone or tablet screenshot from bin/shoot shows the page as a touch screen sees it.
Problem (rule): no record says which widths count as touch. #2028's design-review line says a phone or tablet gets touch and a desktop none, but gives no width, and bin/shoot needs one.
Based on (read): bin/shoot's default sizes are 1440, 820 and 390 px wide (decision shoot-is-one-shared-command).
Based on (read): the design checklist asks for 44 px touch targets on touch screens and 24 px for a mouse (docs/design/checklist.md, ux-a11y-floor).
Departs from: main, where bin/shoot never sets touch — shots below a width cutoff get touch.
Meanwhile: the lane builds option a. Your answer changes only the cutoff.

options.gain: Phones and tablets are shot as #2028 asks, with no config edit in any repo.
options.how: Shots under 1024 px wide get touch: 390 and 820 yes, 1440 no. One rule for every repo.
options.label: Under 1024 px is touch
options.lose: A 1024 px iPad portrait shot gets no touch, and no repo can change that.

options.how: Only phone widths get touch: 390 yes, 820 and 1440 no.
options.label: Under 600 px is touch
options.lose: The 820 px tablet shot stays without touch, against #2028's line.

options.gain: A repo that ships a 1024 px iPad view can shoot it with touch.
options.how: As a, plus a config key touchWidths that a repo sets to list its own touch widths.
options.label: Under 1024 px, and a repo may list its own
options.lose: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo. Each repo can class widths its own way.

options.how: bin/shoot sets touch only for widths a repo lists in touchWidths.
options.label: No default: each repo lists its widths
options.lose: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo. Every repo's shots stay without touch until it edits its config.

ref: step shoot-touch-per-size; #2028 review note 10; decision shoot-is-one-shared-command
reply: Withdrawn 08:29 CST Nov 8. The coordinator took option a (under 1024 px is touch, no override key) as its own pick at 08:22 CST, because the cutoff can be undone (rule parallelism-keep-going). Home: step shoot-touch-per-size, recorded as a coordinator pick, process only. Nothing waits on you.
title: Which screenshot widths should bin/shoot take as touch screens?
